title: Dailybot | JIRA integration, updates on the fly, and other productivity power-ups · Changelog
summary: New Jira integration, real-time report updates, smoother web UX, and chat-based invites. Smarter async workflows with Dailybot.
body_markdown:
We’ve shipped a bundle of productivity improvements. The new Jira integration brings your issues into the flow of team communication. Real-time report updates keep everyone in sync. A smoother web UX makes it easier to manage check-ins and workflows. And chat-based invites simplify onboarding new team members.


Together, these updates make async teamwork smarter and simpler.
